source: 城镇台词（2026-11-27，依据开局参与感策划书与 LORE.md）

priest.tone: A village priest in his sixties: kind, patient, a little tired, speaks like he has buried many people and still believes.

elder.tone: A plain-spoken village elder: practical, warm, a farmer's voice, worried about his people.

inquisitor.tone: A Church inquisitor: cold, precise, never shouts; every sentence sounds like a verdict.

edgewalker.tone: A senior Edgewalker hiding in plain sight: low, quick, wry, a man used to running.

witch.tone: A wounded young woman the Church calls a witch: tired, clear, unafraid; quiet anger under it.

farmwife.tone: A busy farm woman gossiping over a fence: fast, a bit nervous, lowers her voice for secrets.

farmer.tone: A gruff farmer: slow, few words, superstitious.

youth.tone: An excitable teenage boy who repeats rumours as if they were adventures.

bard.tone: A wandering bard singing a fragment of an old song, unaccompanied, half-spoken, half-sung.

watchman.tone: An old night watchman: hoarse, steady, a lantern-carrier who has seen strange things.

child.tone: A lost child of about eight: small voice, shy, then brave.

narrator.tone: An old storyteller reading scripture aloud: slow, unhurried, reverent, close to the microphone (same narrator as the onboarding).

servant.tone: A minor demon of the Seventy-Two speaking through candle smoke: soft, courteous, tempting, never hurried.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 孩子，你醒了。这里是你的故乡，你在这里出生，也在这里受洗。
lines.en: You're awake, child. This is your home; you were born here, and baptised here.
lines.direction: Gentle, welcoming, a hand on the shoulder.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 镇子外面不太平。先拿着这些，够你撑过头几天。
lines.en: It isn't safe beyond the town. Take these; they'll see you through the first days.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 教堂前的圣火会护着你，直到你站稳脚跟。
lines.en: The holy fire before the church will shelter you until you find your feet.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 每天来一趟，教堂总有一份口粮给你。
lines.en: Come by each day. The church always keeps a ration for you.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 今天的口粮。别空着肚子出门。
lines.en: Today's ration. Don't go out on an empty stomach.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 你今天已经领过了。明天再来吧。
lines.en: You've had yours today. Come back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 要学驱魔，先学会看。恶魔留下的痕迹，比它本身好找。
lines.en: To learn exorcism, first learn to look. A demon's traces are easier to find than the demon.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 采三样东西来：清水、盐、圣火的灰。我教你炼一瓶圣水。
lines.en: Bring me three things: clean water, salt, and ash from the holy fire. I'll teach you to make holy water.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 粮仓出事了。跟我来，别碰任何发黑的东西。
lines.en: Something's wrong in the granary. Follow me, and touch nothing that has gone black.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 苍蝇不会无缘无故聚成团。记下来，这是第一处。
lines.en: Flies don't swarm for no reason. Note it; that's the first sign.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 麦子从里面烂了，外面还是金的。贪吃的东西就是这样吃的。
lines.en: The grain rotted from the inside; the outside is still gold. That is how gluttony eats.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 这个印记……三道横，一只眼。我见过它。
lines.en: This mark... three bars and an eye. I've seen it before.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 是蝇王。别西卜的一个化身。它不是全力，但足够吃空一个镇子。
lines.en: It's the Lord of Flies. An avatar of Beelzebub. Not his full strength, but enough to eat a town hollow.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 图腾立在门口。用圣水点燃它，法阵才会亮。
lines.en: Set the totem at the door. Light it with holy water, or the circle won't wake.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 法阵亮了。守住它，别让蝇群扑灭圣火！
lines.en: The circle is lit. Hold it; don't let the swarm smother the fire!

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 撑住，它在变弱！
lines.en: Hold on, it's weakening!

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 它跪下了。由你来裁决：消灭、放逐，还是封印。
lines.en: It kneels. The verdict is yours: destroy, banish, or seal.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 做得好。今晚镇上的人能睡个好觉了。
lines.en: Well done. The town will sleep tonight.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 火灭了……没关系，人都还活着。粮食的事，明天再想办法。
lines.en: The fire's out... never mind. Everyone's alive. We'll sort out the grain tomorrow.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 这瓶圣水是你自己炼的。比我给你的那瓶更管用。
lines.en: You made this holy water yourself. It'll serve you better than any I could give.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 新手的日子结束了。这枚徽章说明你是这个镇的人。
lines.en: Your first days are over. This badge says you belong to this town.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 还有这道通行符。去伊甸之门吧，但别一个人走得太深。
lines.en: And this pass. Go to the Gate of Eden, but don't walk too deep alone.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 你身上有烛烟的味道。我不问。但别让圣卫看见。
lines.en: You smell of candle smoke. I won't ask. But don't let the guards see.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 愿圣火照着你回家。
lines.en: May the holy fire light your way home.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 回来就好。镇上的人都还记得你。
lines.en: Good to have you back. The town still remembers you.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 告示板上有活儿。镇上缺人手，你帮一把，大家都记着。
lines.en: There's work on the notice board. We're short of hands; help out and people will remember.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 大家开始叫你的名字了。铁匠那边会给你便宜些。
lines.en: People are starting to say your name. The smith will give you a better price.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 镇东头有间空屋。你要是愿意，租下来当个家吧。
lines.en: There's an empty house at the east end. Rent it as your home, if you like.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 这张图纸是镇上的老手艺，只给自己人。
lines.en: This pattern is the town's old craft. We only give it to our own.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 从今天起，你就是这个镇的守护者。
lines.en: From today on, you are this town's guardian.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 昨晚的事别往心里去。镇子挨过比这更糟的夜。
lines.en: Don't take last night to heart. This town has survived worse nights.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 房子塌了还能盖，人没了就没了。你救下的比你想的多。
lines.en: Houses can be rebuilt; people can't. You saved more than you think.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 这封信得送到邻镇去。路远，带上地图。
lines.en: This letter must reach the next town. It's a long road; take a map.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 收税的又来了。你帮教廷收，还是帮我们藏？我不怪你。
lines.en: The tax-men are back. Will you collect for the Church, or help us hide the grain? I won't blame you either way.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 粮价涨了一天。没事，熬过去就好。
lines.en: Grain's dear for a day. No matter; we'll get through it.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.zh: 镇子不大，但它是你的。
lines.en: It's not a big town, but it's yours.

lines.speaker: inquisitor
lines.zh: 以教廷之名：此女与恶魔立约，明日日出，火刑。
lines.en: In the name of the Church: this woman has made a pact with demons. At sunrise, she burns.

lines.speaker: inquisitor
lines.zh: 谁替她求情，谁就和她同罪。
lines.en: Whoever pleads for her shares her guilt.

lines.speaker: inquisitor
lines.zh: 犯人跑了！封住镇口！
lines.en: The prisoner is loose! Seal the gates!

lines.speaker: inquisitor
lines.zh: 你们跑不远的。林子也是教廷的。
lines.en: You won't get far. The woods belong to the Church too.

lines.speaker: inquisitor
lines.zh: 放下她，我只记你一笔。
lines.en: Put her down, and I'll only write your name.

lines.speaker: inquisitor
lines.zh: 孤堡的墙不是为挡恶魔造的，是为挡忘了神的人。
lines.en: The walls of the Lone Fort weren't built against demons. They were built against those who forget God.

lines.speaker: inquisitor
lines.zh: 每一份名单都有用。今天的邻居，明天的证人。
lines.en: Every list has its use. Today's neighbour is tomorrow's witness.

lines.speaker: inquisitor
lines.zh: ……这一次算你们赢。
lines.en: ...You win this time.
lines.direction: Through clenched teeth, almost a whisper.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 嘘。别回头，听我说。
lines.en: Shh. Don't turn around. Listen.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 明早要烧的那个人没做过他们说的事。我需要人手。
lines.en: The one they're burning at dawn didn't do what they say. I need hands.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 天黑以后，到刑台后面的巷子找我。
lines.en: After dark, find me in the alley behind the scaffold.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 听好：一个人点火引开圣卫，一个人割绳，一个人挡住审判官。
lines.en: Listen: one lights a fire to draw the guards, one cuts the ropes, one holds the inquisitor.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 只有你一个？那我去点火，绳子交给你。
lines.en: Just you? Then I'll light the fire. The ropes are yours.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 圣卫只打晕，别杀。他们也是被派来的。
lines.en: Knock the guards out; don't kill them. They were sent too.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 火起来了！现在！
lines.en: Fire's lit! Now!

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 绳子断了，扶她走！
lines.en: The ropes are cut, get her up!

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 她走不快。挡住后面的人！
lines.en: She can't move fast. Hold off the ones behind us!

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 再往前就是林子了，撑住。
lines.en: The woods are just ahead. Hold on.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 到了。这里他们找不到。
lines.en: We're here. They won't find us here.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 你救的不是女巫。她是我们的人，是边缘者。
lines.en: You didn't save a witch. She's one of us. An Edgewalker.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 营地的门一直开着。想通了就来。
lines.en: The camp's door is always open. Come when you've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: edgewalker
lines.zh: 教堂的蜡烛，教廷的圣水……总有人得让他们知道，不是所有人都怕。
lines.en: The church candles, the Church's holy water... someone has to show them not everyone is afraid.
lines.direction: Handing out a secret job, a half-smile.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 谢谢你……我还以为今天就是最后一天。
lines.en: Thank you... I thought today was my last.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 你知道所罗门王吗？他是第一个被记下名字的边缘者。
lines.en: Do you know of King Solomon? He was the first Edgewalker whose name was written down.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 他和七十二位魔神立约，把它们封进柱子里。没有杀，也没有放。
lines.en: He made pacts with seventy-two demons and sealed them in pillars. He didn't kill them, and he didn't free them.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 后来教廷拿走了那些柱子，把它们当成军械库。
lines.en: Later the Church took those pillars and turned them into an armoury.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 每个边缘者都分到一根柱、一位魔神。我们借它的力，它借我们的心。
lines.en: Every Edgewalker is given a pillar and a demon. We borrow its strength; it borrows our hearts.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 教廷需要我们去打仗。打完了，就叫我们女巫。
lines.en: The Church needs us for its wars. When the war's over, it calls us witches.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 我没有杀过人。我只是不肯再替他们杀人。
lines.en: I never killed anyone. I only refused to kill for them any more.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 镇上的人不坏。他们只是怕，而怕最好用。
lines.en: The townsfolk aren't wicked. They're afraid, and fear is easy to use.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 这是我身上唯一值钱的东西。拿着，别推辞。
lines.en: This is the only thing of value I have. Take it; don't refuse.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 如果有一天你也被教廷当成怪物，来林子里找我们。
lines.en: If the Church ever calls you a monster too, come find us in the woods.
lines.direction: Slow, the most important line; let it land.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 你又来了。坐吧，火是暖的。
lines.en: You came back. Sit; the fire's warm.

lines.speaker: witch
lines.zh: 祭坛在营地后面。想清楚了再点那支黑蜡烛。
lines.en: The altar is behind the camp. Think hard before you light the black candle.

lines.speaker: farmwife
lines.zh: 你闻到没有？粮仓那边一股酸味，麦子都发黑了。
lines.en: Can you smell it? Something sour by the granary. The grain's gone black.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.zh: 苍蝇。成团成团的。冬天哪来的苍蝇。
lines.en: Flies. Swarms of them. Where do flies come from at this time of year?

lines.speaker: youth
lines.zh: 老约拿家的人都在闹肚子，说是吃了新磨的面！
lines.en: Old Jonah's whole family is sick. They say it was the new flour!

lines.speaker: farmwife
lines.zh: 神父今天在粮仓门口站了好久，脸色可难看了。
lines.en: The priest stood at the granary door for ages today. He looked awful.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.zh: 墓地的土是松的。像是有人从里面往外挖。
lines.en: The graveyard soil is loose. As if someone dug their way out.

lines.speaker: youth
lines.zh: 我昨晚看见一个人站在路口，没有脸！真的，没有脸！
lines.en: Last night I saw someone standing at the crossroads with no face! Honest, no face!

lines.speaker: farmwife
lines.zh: 你别盯着它看……可也别背过身去。我奶奶就是这么说的。
lines.en: Don't stare at it... but don't turn your back on it either. That's what my grandmother said.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.zh: 今晚关好门。守夜人说狗叫了一整夜。
lines.en: Bar your door tonight. The watchman says the dogs barked all night.

lines.speaker: youth
lines.zh: 审判官进城了！带着一车柴火！
lines.en: The inquisitor's come to town! With a whole cart of firewood!

lines.speaker: farmwife
lines.zh: 广场上在搭刑台……明早要烧女巫。
lines.en: They're building a scaffold in the square... they'll burn a witch in the morning.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.zh: 那姑娘给我家孩子看过病。我不信她是女巫。
lines.en: That girl once nursed my child. I don't believe she's a witch.

lines.speaker: farmwife
lines.zh: 嘘，别乱说话。圣卫在听。
lines.en: Hush, watch your tongue. The guards are listening.

lines.speaker: farmwife
lines.zh: 谢谢你，谢谢……我还以为再也见不到家了。
lines.en: Thank you, thank you... I thought I'd never see home again.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.zh: 欠你一条命。有事说一声。
lines.en: I owe you my life. Just say the word.

lines.speaker: youth
lines.zh: 你是怎么做到的？教教我！
lines.en: How did you do that? Teach me!

lines.speaker: farmwife
lines.zh: 来，拿着，自家烤的。
lines.en: Here, take this. Baked it myself.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.zh: 镇子能撑到今天，多亏了你这样的人。
lines.en: This town's still standing because of people like you.

lines.speaker: youth
lines.zh: 等我长大了，也要跟你一样！
lines.en: When I grow up, I'm going to be just like you!

lines.speaker: bard
lines.zh: 世界曾是一整块，神说要有光；后来权与力分了家，大地就碎成了七样。
lines.en: The world was whole when God said light; then Might and Authority parted, and the land broke into seven.
lines.direction: Sung slowly, a ballad fragment, unaccompanied.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.zh: 七位领主坐王座下，傲慢、嫉妒、贪与饱；谁拿走他们的刀，谁就拿走他们的影。
lines.en: Seven lords beneath the throne: pride, envy, greed and gluttony; who takes their blades, takes their shadows too.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.zh: 所罗门戴冠走进深渊，七十二个名字带回人间；柱子立着，锁还在，钥匙在教廷的袖子里。
lines.en: Solomon wore his crown into the deep, and brought back seventy-two names; the pillars stand, the locks still hold, the key is in the Church's sleeve.
lines.direction: Sung, ending on a sly spoken note.

lines.speaker: watchman
lines.zh: 夜里绕镇走一圈。看见什么都别出声，回来告诉我。
lines.en: Walk the town once tonight. Whatever you see, keep quiet and tell me.

lines.speaker: watchman
lines.zh: 墓地那边的灯总是先灭。你去看看。
lines.en: The lamps by the graveyard always go out first. Go and look.

lines.speaker: watchman
lines.zh: 土松了？……那就是了。要出事了。
lines.en: The soil's loose?... Then that's it. Something's coming.

lines.speaker: watchman
lines.zh: 走完了？好。拿去，这是守夜的钱。
lines.en: All the way round? Good. Here, a watchman's wage.

lines.speaker: child
lines.zh: 你是来找我的吗？
lines.en: Have you come to find me?

lines.speaker: child
lines.zh: 我迷路了，是那个戴兜帽的叔叔给我饭吃。
lines.en: I got lost, and the man in the hood gave me food.

lines.speaker: child
lines.zh: 他说别告诉神父，可我觉得他是好人。
lines.en: He said not to tell the priest, but I think he's a good man.

lines.speaker: child
lines.zh: 我们回家吧。我不怕了。
lines.en: Let's go home. I'm not scared any more.

lines.speaker: servant
lines.zh: 是谁逆着画了圈，点了黑烛……啊，是你。
lines.en: Who drew the circle backwards and lit the black candle... ah. It's you.

lines.speaker: servant
lines.zh: 教廷给你的是锁链和名单。我们给你的是名字。
lines.en: The Church gave you chains and lists. We give you a name.

lines.speaker: servant
lines.zh: 代价？一半的血，一枚印。很公道。
lines.en: The price? Half your blood, and one mark. Very fair.

lines.speaker: servant
lines.zh: 签吧。从此教廷的火烧不到你，只会追着你。
lines.en: Sign. From now on the Church's fire can't burn you. It can only chase you.

lines.speaker: servant
lines.zh: 契成。欢迎回家。
lines.en: It is done. Welcome home.

lines.speaker: servant
lines.zh: 犹豫了？没关系，蜡烛还会再亮。
lines.en: Hesitating? No matter. The candle will light again.

lines.speaker: watchman
lines.zh: 它们从墓地出来了！看着它们，别让它们靠近镇口！
lines.en: They're coming out of the graveyard! Watch them; don't let them reach the gate!

lines.speaker: watchman
lines.zh: 有人被拖走了！快追！
lines.en: Someone's been dragged off! After them!

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 最后那个……它在显形。小心，它不再怕光了。
lines.en: That last one... it's taking shape. Careful. It doesn't fear the light any more.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.zh: 天亮了。它们回到土里去了。
lines.en: Dawn. They've gone back into the earth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 平原上的风一直吹，像在数还有多少人没有回家。
lines.en: The wind on the plains never stops, as if counting who has not come home.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 林子记得每一个走进来的人，也记得没走出去的。
lines.en: The forest remembers everyone who walks in, and everyone who never walked out.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 原野的花开得很乱，好像没人告诉它们世界碎过。
lines.en: The wildflowers grow in disorder, as if no one told them the world had broken.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 雾月花在白天也发着光，像替谁守着一盏灯。
lines.en: The mistmoon flowers glow even by day, like a lamp kept for someone.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 这片林子金黄得像祭坛上的麦，丰饶是给活人的。
lines.en: This wood is gold like grain upon an altar. Plenty is for the living.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 沙漠什么都不留，连脚印也只借给你一会儿。
lines.en: The desert keeps nothing. Even your footprints are only lent.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 雪把一切都盖平了，好坏都一样白。
lines.en: The snow levels everything. Good and bad, all the same white.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 云杉底下，地热在冒气，大地还没有睡着。
lines.en: Under the spruce the earth still steams. The land has not yet slept.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 平顶的山像被一刀削过，那是神陨那天留下的。
lines.en: The flat-topped hills look cut by a single blade, a scar from the day God fell.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 风把沙漠一层层剥开，底下是更老的颜色。
lines.en: The wind peels the desert layer by layer, down to older colours.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 焦木还站着，只是不再长叶子了。
lines.en: The burnt trees still stand. They simply no longer grow leaves.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 石头站成了林子，比树还耐心。
lines.en: Here the stones stand like a forest, more patient than trees.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 高原上的颜色不对。这里的东西在等人犯错。
lines.en: The colours on this plateau are wrong. Things here wait for you to make a mistake.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 冰原上的尖塔一年长一寸，没有人知道它们要去哪里。
lines.en: The ice spires grow an inch a year. No one knows where they are going.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 山顶离天近，离人远。
lines.en: The summit is close to heaven, and far from people.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 大地在这里流血，流成了火。
lines.en: Here the land bleeds, and the blood is fire.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 这里打过的仗还没打完，只是人都死了。
lines.en: The war fought here has not ended. Only the people have.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 海崖把大陆的边缘咬得参差不齐。
lines.en: The sea cliffs have gnawed the edge of the continent ragged.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 水从碎裂的大地之间流过，把各国连在一起。
lines.en: Water runs between the broken lands and ties the nations together.
lines.direction: Quiet, first sight of a new land; leave a breath at the end.
